name: Battle of Hillsbrad
summary: Horde forces strike at Azurelode Mine in the Battle of Hillsbrad. High Executor Darthalia orders them to kill Foreman Bonds and his crew, cutting iron shipments to Alliance armories.

sections.title: Severing the Iron Supply
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia marked Azurelode Mine as vital to human strength after Horde forces seized the Hillsbrad Town Registry in earlier raids. The mine lies just south of Hillsbrad Fields, where workers keep extracting rich iron ore for Alliance weaponsmiths and armories. If the mine keeps operating, Southshore can rearm and strengthen its garrisons, undoing Tarren Mill's earlier victories.

sections.title: A Decisive Message
sections.body: Darthalia orders Horde forces to kill Foreman Bonds, the human overseer, and a significant part of his workforce. The assault reaches into the mine's dark shafts to break production. It sends Southshore a clear warning: the Forsaken can reach its supply lines and isolated labor camps.

sections.title: Spoils for the Dark Lady
sections.body: Sylvanas Windrunner's forces also seek the mine's rich ore veins for their own foundries. Tarren Mill needs a steady supply of metal to make weapons and plate for the war across Lordaeron. The ore can turn a former human asset into a source of Forsaken arms.

faq.q: Why is Azurelode Mine so important to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Azurelode Mine supplies high-grade iron ore to Alliance armories. Taking it deprives garrisons such as Southshore of materials for forging and puts the ore in the Undercity's hands to equip Forsaken forces.
Foreman Bonds is the human overseer of the Azurelode excavation. He manages the miners and can call on stalwart dwarven defenders when cornered deep in the lower chambers.

faq.q: Where is the Azurelode Mine located?
faq.answer: Azurelode Mine lies in the hills south of Hillsbrad Fields, west of Southshore along the coastline bluffs.

faq.q: How did Darthalia find out about the mine's operations?
faq.answer: Darthalia learned the mine was active and important to supply lines by reviewing the Hillsbrad Town Registry. Horde operatives recovered it in earlier strikes on human settlements.

faq.q: What happens after Foreman Bonds is slain?
faq.answer: With the mine crippled and its resources marked for Forsaken control, High Executor Darthalia widens the offensive against Hillsbrad's remaining infrastructure and presses closer to Southshore.

faq.q: Does the Alliance defend the mine?
faq.answer: Yes. Armed Alliance guards watch the entrance, and human miners work the shafts. Foreman Bonds can also call on tough dwarven reinforcements deep in the tunnels.

angles.text: As an Undead, taking Azurelode Mine secures iron for the Deathguard and turns human industry toward arming Sylvanas's armies across Lordaeron.
As Horde, disrupting Hillsbrad's main metal supply eases pressure on the Tarren Mill frontline and makes it harder for human troops to replace their equipment.
As a miner, you can see why Azurelode Mine's rich iron veins make it a point of conflict for those seeking valuable ore.
